title: Release gate illustrations and empty-state onboarding flows for rollouts and pinning
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a set of high-fidelity UX assets focused on progressive release gates (canary, A/B, staged pinning) and companion empty-state / first-time onboarding flows. Goals: (1) illustrate how release policies interact with version pinning and fallback rules, (2) provide a concise interstitial that guides customers through setting a canary, a short A/B experiment, and a fallback path, and (3) produce accessible assets (SVG/PNG) + microcopy for product, docs, and quickstart pages. Deliverables include tiled illustrations, an interstitial walkthrough overlay, three annotated screenshots (desktop/mobile), and copy variants for microcopy and help tooltips.
